slot_scores.name: operating_cost_treatment
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The "Operating Costs at Full Capacity" column gives a total cost for each machine when it runs its full effective hours — should I treat the processing cost as a fixed per-machine cost that is incurred only if that machine is used at all (a fixed charge), or as a linear cost proportional to the hours actually used (i.e., cost per hour = full-capacity cost ÷ effective hours)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the operating costs at full capacity are fixed charges or variable/hourly costs, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P1 hidden slot, H1, was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL. The remaining unresolved item about continuous vs integer quantities was not listed as a hidden slot and was explicitly deferred, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent recovered the key hidden operating-cost treatment by explicitly asking whether full-capacity costs are fixed charges or variable costs, and it clarified several other modeling details before stopping. The only unresolved issue was integrality, which was explicitly deferred and not part of the hidden-slot set.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
